title: Eliud Kipchoge of Kenya runs marathon under two hours
summary: Кенийн гүйгч Элиуд Кипчоге марафоныг хоёр цаг хүрэхгүй хугацаанд гүйсэн тухай.

source.name: Wikinews
source.creditLine: Published Sunday, October 13, 2019. The text of this article is licensed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 License

changes: Dateline, sources section, page links and the “Have an opinion on this story?” prompt removed; text otherwise unchanged.

options: He ran a marathon in under two hours.
He set an official world record in Vienna.
He won an Olympic gold medal in Berlin.
questions.explain: "Eliud Kipchoge from Kenya ran a marathon in less than two hours" гэж бичсэн. Гэхдээ энэ нь албан ёсны дэлхийн рекорд биш.

questions.prompt: Why was his time not an official world record?
options: It was not an open race.
He ran without any other runners.
The course was shorter than a marathon.
questions.explain: "it was not an 'open race' of the IAAF" гэж бичсэн. Түүнтэй хамт 42 гүйгч гүйсэн, зам нь бүтэн 42.195 км байсан.

questions.prompt: Who were the “pacemakers” in this text?
options: Supporting runners who ran with him
questions.explain: "42 pacemakers — supporting runners" гэж тайлбарласан, "They ran with Kipchoge" гэж бичсэн. Тэд түүнтэй хамт гүйж туслсан.
